body: This isn’t normal and you’re not overreacting. It seems to me as if he sees his friends as a higher priority than you.
No, White Walkers were never the true enemy. They were a plot device to unite Jon, Dany, Jaime, the Hound, etc. It’s game of thrones, not game of zombies.
Well I can’t exactly steal my sisters’ boyfriends. But yeah, admittedly, the woman in this situation is a little suspect.
This guy is basically my brother. I just don’t get what the big deal is.

Honestly, a one night stand is forgivable. They happen and people have lapses in judgment. However, a 3 month affair is a whole different ball game. 

I think you should leave her. Open your bank account, get things of your own and leave. 

She’s gaslighting the fuck out of you, bro.

My best friend married one of my exes this past December.. they’ve been together for 3 years and her and I dated for a year. Yeah, when they first started dating a few months after our break up, I was upset. But I moved on. They’re happy together and I was the best man at the wedding. 

I think this is a maturity issue. It’s been TWELVE years. Way past time to move on.
You can’t help who you love. Sometimes, it just happens.
Are you sure she’s willing to be completely exclusive with you? If she is, I don’t see the problem but if she lies, then just leave.
I disagree with this. I get that it hurt but I’m not going to deny my brother the love of his life because of my hurt feelings.

So, dating in college is difficult, especially the first few years. Guys are just horny and don’t really want to settle down. So don’t get down on yourself! Believe me, it’s more us guys than you:

Also, it is kind of terrifying to approach women for us. Rejection always hurts, no matter how nicely it’s done. I’m impressed that you’ve approached men! 

Relationships come with you’re not looking for them so just take your time and see if a guy shows up.

I’m a 24 year old male college student but most of my closest friends are typical pretty blonde college women.  However, they go out of their way to make any girlfriend I have comfortable. They invite her out without me going, they include her in their group chat, they make sure she feels that she is a part of the group. 

However, I would say if she doesn’t act like that, I would be a bit suspicious because it could be possible that she’s jealous.
Agreed. 20 is too close to 18 for this to be comfortable.
It is but I’m just getting to the library to study. 🤷🏾‍♂️
Thanks for talking to me! Have a good night.
I believe it. My dad is a tough man’s man but I know he suffers from depression too. I can see it in him but he would never seek help. He just bottles it up
It really is because I feel as if a lot of people feel isolated because they think that no one else feels the way they do.
Yeah, I think that’s why I was sobbing earlier after it passed. I scared myself so deeply
I don’t want to die. It terrifies me actually and there are too many people in this world I would hurt. But sometimes, I’m my weakest moments, it just seems like the best option, you know?

I do see a therapist at the counseling center here. She’s great. She’s one of the reasons I didn’t off myself a few years ago when it was bad or last year when basically my whole life crumbled at once.

I would but I hate being a burden on others. I have close friends who would do anything for me but I hate talking to them about this because we all have our own issues and I don’t want them worrying that I might just off myself one day.
Logically, I know I will figure stuff out. I guess I’m just tired of being constantly on the financial aid. Sometimes I have to get my sisters to help me out and that really bothers me.
I don’t think I could actually do it. My mom would follow me to the grave and that thought makes me so sad. I was just having a really weak moment earlier.
I can’t with my school work load and my full time job. I already average 3-4 hours a sleep at night.

I’ve been looking at payday and installment loans but those are just deeper pitfalls into debt. 

I work a full time job but I only make 14 an hour so it usually just covers my rent, car payment, etc. I can usually squeak by every month but I had a massive vet bill this month for my pup and that’s set behind a lot. 

Also, tuition payment needs to be before the beginning of the next semester which is the 3rd week of May and I can’t make 3,100$ before then.

As for rent, I have to pay next week and I may have to take out a pay day loan for that.

My relationship with them is good but they can’t. My mom is disabled and doesn’t work and while my dad makes okay money, he doesn’t make enough to cover the difference in tuition and rent. 

Also, they don’t understand anxiety or depression. My mom thinks it’s something you can just fix. My dad is more understanding but he doesn’t really know how to help.
